# Hawkynt archive and compression packages

TANGERINE ZIP uses `Hawkynt.FileFormats.Archives` and its dependency
`Hawkynt.Compression.Core`, version `1.0.0.776`, for ARJ, ARC, ACE archive
creation and Unix `compress` (`.Z`) creation. These packages are authored by
Hawkynt and licensed under **LGPL-3.0-or-later**, independently of this
project's MIT license.

- Upstream source: https://github.com/Hawkynt/CompressionWorkbench
- Archive package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Hawkynt.FileFormats.Archives/1.0.0.776
- Compression core package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Hawkynt.Compression.Core/1.0.0.776
- License text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html

No upstream source files were copied into this repository. The application
consumes the packages through their NuGet references.
